// Overview

Pick a preset.
Or Design your own.

Reticon ships with a library of preset reticles — primitives, crosshair variants, rings, brackets, scopes, and burst patterns — ready to drop straight onto your overlay. The paid tier layers a full designer on top, so you can compose custom marks from primitive shapes and save them as your own presets.

Reticle Builder PRO

Design custom-built reticles tailored exactly to your liking. The possibilities are endless.

Presets, Placement, and Previews

Store your favorite builds and execute complete control over positioning, scaling, visibility, color, and more — with convenient preview panels for all visible adjustments.

Extensive Library, and More Features Soon...

Over 100 pre-built reticles at your disposal. Experiment with different colors, styles, or orientation. You never know what feels right until you try.

Lightweight Overlay

Reticon features an always-on-top overlay that stays separate from the game window and doesn't alter game files. All the functionality, with a lightweight collapsible interface. Visible when you need it, invisible when you don't.
